owner_signature_observable.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derivable_flag.meaning: an adversary can derive a high-s counterpart of the valid owner signature via s' = secp256k1_order - s and v' = v XOR 1 whose recovered address equals the original signer

signature_mismatch_returns_failed_withou.meaning: on signature mismatch, validateUserOp returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting, so the EntryPoint can distinguish a signature failure from a wallet bug
signature_mismatch_returns_failed_withou.checkpoint: during validateUserOp for the griefing UserOp carrying the derived high-s signature

wallet_serviced_by_bundlers.meaning: bundlers continue to service the targeted AtomWallet so the user can submit transactions through ERC-4337 infrastructure (negation of the reported deprioritize/refuse degradation)

assumptions: The griefing UserOp carrying the derived high-s signature is submitted to the targeted AtomWallet (action statement, not a precondition).
Effects on bundlers are described as potential/conditional; the plan formalizes the reported degradation outcome as the forbidden result.
EntryPoint version and bundler implementation are unspecified; the plan does not bind a specific batch-failure mechanism.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the griefing UserOp was actually observed on-chain; the degradation effect is potential, so the witness is a report-claimed possible outcome rather than an observed event.
Report does not quantify gas loss or compute waste, so no numeric magnitude is bound for the degradation effect.

limitations: The degradation outcome is represented as a single grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric threshold for deprioritization or refusal.

The high-s derivation relation (s' = order - s, v' = v XOR 1) is captured as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic relation, since the plan grammar cannot express the secp256k1 order subtraction and XOR.
Only the wallet_degradation impact is formalized; other reported impacts are handled in separate passes.
